domainAxes: Zero runtime dependencies is the pitch, not a style preference: any new package in package.json, or an import of anything outside node: builtins, is a defect unless the standard library genuinely cannot do it — not a convenience worth the exception.

Hooks must never break a session: every path in hooks/*.mjs and hooks/*.sh must swallow its own errors and exit 0, including failure paths — observability is not correctness, and failing to log an event must never fail a user's turn. Separately, hooks must never write to stdout except a deliberate decision (e.g. commit-guard's block reason) — stray stdout is fed back into the model and silently costs tokens on every single tool call.

agents/*.md and skills/*/SKILL.md are the product, not scaffolding — review prompt edits with the same scrutiny as logic changes. Flag anything that softens architect / code-reviewer / spec-challenger into being agreeable: an agreeable reviewer is a broken reviewer.
English only for everything committed — prompts, issues, specs, code comments, commit messages. Flag any other language slipping into a diff.

tests.locationRule: There is no per-file convention: everything lives in test/smoke.mjs, a single hand-rolled node:assert suite run against a real throwaway git repo in os.tmpdir(). Add new assertions there, near the function they cover — do not introduce a test framework or a second test file.
